purpose: Reproducible reference for the independent ORCA behavior-cloning run and the later dynamic-collision inspection. The checkpoint is the frozen baseline; do not overwrite it when changing the observation, the dataset filter, or the shield.

observation_contract.validity_channel: last dimension of each obstacle node; HeteroEncoder masks with block[..., -1] > 0.5
observation_contract.obstacle_velocity: read by sensed_cylinders and discarded in graph_observation; not in this checkpoint

behavior_cloning.launch: source activate.sh from the Isaac work tree, then run with PYTHONPATH set to this repo's configurable-pursuit directory
behavior_cloning.label: pre-brake ORCA intent
behavior_cloning.stop: validation normalized MSE plateau for 5 epochs, maximum 40 epochs; 0.35 is not a gate
behavior_cloning.split: every 8th qualifying episode is validation; split is by episode, not by adjacent fragments
behavior_cloning.collection_seeds: scene seeds start at 1000 and increase as episodes are reset

inspection.paired_definition: student final outcome is dynamic collision and the teacher never hits a static or dynamic obstacle on the same scene seed
inspection.note: The original closed-loop pair was not logged per seed. This inspection is a seeded replay, not those exact 16 trajectories. The first collection's 19 discarded episodes were not saved; coverage.json is a later replay with 24 discarded episodes.

reinforcement_learning.command: python -m parallel.training.mappo --teacher none --from-bc results/bc-orca-300/bc_orca.pt --num-envs 128 --rl-steps 5000000 --scene full --perception mid360 --clip 0.08 --kl-coef 0.5 --kl-target 0.03 --entropy 0.01 --output results/mappo-bc-rl
reinforcement_learning.o2o: frozen BC policy KL coefficient 0.5 for the first 20 percent of RL steps, then linear decay to 0; PPO ratio clip 0.92-1.08; stop an update after two minibatches with approximate KL above 0.03; initial log_std -2.2; roll back if confirmed capture stays 0.08 below the BC opening rate
